I'm going to try and make this post as short as I can. Don't worry or get too excited, I won't be gone for too long.

About a month ago I gave myself a challenge - one that I haven't taken before. I went 1 full week without internet - to an extent. I used it to look up phone numbers, still played a game on my phone (about 20 mins a day), and looked up a few recipes. I kept my internet usage to a bare minimum. If I didn't have a family, I would have unplugged the damn thing all together. I said I would give a full report and I never did. To be completely honest - I don't feel there was too much to report on as I wasn't as accomplished as I was hoping to be.

Don't get me wrong - I felt way more human. I interacted more with my wife, I played with my son, I got chores done, but I didn't feel any huge changes - everything was subtle. However, it was much like doing an extreme diet - I felt the effects while on it, but once my date was up I went right back to mindlessly scrolling/posting. It happened slowly at first, but just today I have already spent 2 hours browsing for no damn reason.

So what prompted this change? First, I can't remember a time since I first got a computer (aside from vacations) where I didn't spend every day on it. Even without internet (in the beginning) I was fascinated with it. I never put that fascination to good use and learned programming/hardware repair or anything like that - It was and always has been to me an interactive television. My punishment for bad grads when I was young was "no computer for a week". Now I have a mini computer in my pocket that I can use to waste time. No need for a bulky laptop to browse the chans/Voat on my couch - I can use my phone. But there is a huge downside that we all feel. It's all I want to do. I have problems in my life that I decide not to fix because I can just distract myself. Chores go undone, sloppy dinners thrown together because I just didn't feel like being creative. Hell, even my sex life suffers to an extent because of it.

So, even though my week off wasn't what I had expected it to be - I did feel like a new man. I felt amazing. My depression was lessened because I was tackling small problems before they became big ones. So I have decided to take a full month off the internet. Starting tomorrow (my birthday) I will not use the internet until 8/23/17. I have decided to put a small caveat in there - I may post original content. I think I should reward my brain for doing the right thing (being creative and constructive) with a dose of internet - but only to share my work. I know what a slippery slope this kind of allowance can be, so hence why I am undecided.

Finally - why I have chosen my birthday to do this. I have a female friend and every year she sets a goal she wants to accomplish on her birthday. She achieves this every year before her next birthday. I really love this take on life and so I have decided to mimic it. Except, I give myself a month and set my goals to be a bit smaller.

Anyway, that turned into a bit of a ramble. I love you guys - truly. I will miss you all, but my real world life needs repair.
Have a great month. Already looking forward to welcoming you back.
